results.title: Jin Jiang Hotels and Trip.com Sign Strategic MOU to Deepen ASEAN Engagement
results.description: SINGAPORE , Aug. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A subsidiary of Jin Jiang Hotels , a leading global hospitality company, has established a strategic collaboration with the leading international travel service provider Trip.com Travel Singapore Pte. Ltd., to deliver value to travelers visiting the ASEAN region. The two companies signed a three-year MoU that will see them cooperate in leveraging their respective ecosystems and platform strengths across ten ASEAN nations — Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Cambodia, Myanmar, Laos, and Brunei — to jointly drive brand equity and further develop hospitality ecosystems in the ASEAN region. Building a New Model for ASEAN Hospitality Collaboration This long-term strategic alliance is rooted in resource exchange, shared strengths, and co-marketing. A key highlight is the introduction of a unified fixed commission structure for participating properties of the subsidiary of Jin Jiang Hotels across the ASEAN nations covered by the MoU. This standardized framework will replace traditional, volatile floating commission models to improve commercial transparency, enhance cost predictability, and provide a more stable foundation for sustainable, higher-certainty growth for the hotel franchisee. Accelerating a New 'Tourism + Accommodation' Ecosystem The cooperation will also leverage the two companies' complementary strengths across the travel value chain to create a seamless, full-service loop spanning cross-border booking, destination activities, localized stays, and after-sales support. The powerful synergy between the offline hospitality portfolio of the subsidiary of Jin Jiang Hotels and Trip.com's online global traffic will address the critical pain point of overseas customer acquisition for ASEAN hotels, significantly boosting local occupancy rates and diversifying the guest mix through an integrated, one-stop solution. Deepening their collaboration through joint marketing and resource integration will enable the companies to build an integrated "tourism + accommodation" ecosystem across ASEAN aimed at strengthening tourism connectivity, supporting local hospitality ecosystems, and delivering value to travelers. In parallel to this strategic cooperation, the subsidiary of Jin Jiang Hotels has established a robust localized footprint in Southeast Asia, deploying dedicated development and operations teams in Malaysia, Indonesia, and Vietnam. By leveraging its high-quality standards, intelligent systems, and the GPP (Global Purchasing Platform), the subsidiary of Jin Jiang Hotels is smoothly adapting to regional habits while driving local economic synergy. This infrastructure will ultimately accelerate the company's tailored, brand-led, and scalable international development, providing support for upcoming property openings across Southeast Asia and driving growth with a deeper localized presence.

results.title: طقس الأربعاء.. أمطار رعدية متوسطة إلى غزيرة ودرجات حرارة مرتفعة
results.description:
يتوقع المركز الوطني للأرصاد في تقريره عن حالة الطقس اليوم الأربعاء على مناطق المملكة، أن تتهيأ الفرصة لهطول أمطار رعدية متوسطة إلى غزيرة تؤدي إلى جريان السيول، مصحوبة بزخات من البرد ورياح نشطة مثيرة للأتربة والغبار على أجزاء من مناطق جازان وعسير والباحة ومكة المكرمة والمدينة المنورة.
في حين تبقى درجات الحرارة العظمى مرتفعة على أجزاء من المنطقة الشرقية، مع فرصة تكوّن الضباب خلال ساعات الصباح الباكر على الأجزاء الساحلية منها، كما لا يُستبعد تكوّن السحب الرعدية الممطرة المصحوبة برياح نشطة على الأجزاء الجنوبية منها، كذلك على أجزاء من مناطق نجران، الرياض وحائل.

البحر الأحمر

الرياح السطحية: شمالية غربية إلى غربية على الجزء الشمالي والأوسط بسرعة 18-42 كم/ساعة، وشمالية غربية إلى غربية تتحول بعد الظهيرة جنوبية شرقية إلى جنوبية غربية على الجزء الجنوبي بسرعة 10-32 كم/ساعة، تصل إلى أكثر من 50 كم/ساعة مع تكوّن السحب الرعدية الممطرة على الجزء الجنوبي.

ارتفاع الموج: من نصف المتر إلى متر ونصف يصل إلى أعلى من مترين مع تكوّن السحب الرعدية الممطرة على الجزء الجنوبي.

حالة البحر: خفيف إلى متوسط الموج يصل إلى مائج مع تكوّن السحب الرعدية الممطرة على الجزء الجنوبي.

الخليج العربي

الرياح السطحية: جنوبية شرقية إلى جنوبية غربية على الجزء الشمالي والأوسط، وشمالية شرقية إلى جنوبية شرقية على الجزء الجنوبي بسرعة 10-30 كم/ساعة.

ارتفاع الموج: من نصف المتر إلى متر.

حالة البحر: خفيف الموج.

طقس المنطقة الشرقية

نبه المركز الوطني للأرصاد في تقريره عن حالة الطقس من موجة حارة وأمطار خفيفة وأتربة مثارة على المنطقة الشرقية اليوم الثلاثاء.
تستمر الموجة الحارة 6 ساعات من 11 صباحًا حتى 5 مساء، على الخفجي والنعيرية وحفر الباطن وقرية العليا والأحساء والعديد وبقيق
ويصاحبها ارتفاع في درجات الحرارة من (47 – 48) درجة مئوية.
بينما يُتوقع أن تشهد حفر الباطن أتربة مثارة من الساعة 9 صباحًا وتستمر حتى الساعة 7 مساء.
مع رياح نشطة تصل سرعتها إلى (40 – 49) كيلومترًا/ساعة، وتدني في مدى الرؤية الأفقية (3 – 5) كيلومترات.
وتشهد الأحساء والعبيلة والعديد وذعبلوتن أمطارًا خفيفة من الساعة 11 صباحًا حتى الساعة 6 مساء.
ويصاحب الأمطار: رياح نشطة، وتدني في مدى الرؤية الأفقية، وصواعق رعدية.

Following the enthusiastic response to the Phase 1, the new phase introduces an enhanced collection of exclusive themed rewards, spending incentives, and the Link Fresh Markets' health campaign—bringing the "taste of home" to communities across Hong Kong. “McDull Dining Treats" Redemption brought you a brand-new themed ceramic tableware set "McDull Dining Treats Phase 2" Redemption Bringing the Brand-New Mrs. Mak & McDull Tableware Sets The second phase of the "McDull Dining Treats Phase 2" Redemption campaign features a brand-new series of practical and stylish tableware inspired by the "Savour the Tastes of Home in Hundred Ways" theme. Starting today, customers spending $60 or more at any of the 24 designated Link Shopping Centres can collect a stamp; upon collecting the required number of stamps, shoppers can redeem a set of Mrs. Mak & McDull themed ceramic tableware adding a touch of home warmth to everyday dining. Earn Dining Cash Coupons with Octopus and JoyYou Cards at Link Shopping Centres To thank the community for its continued support, Link has partnered with Octopus to launch the exclusive "Dining Rewards" programme. JoyYou Card holders can also enjoy special promotional offers during the "JoyYou Fest" from 28 August to 10 September. The initiative encourages shoppers to recharge their mind and body while grocery shopping at the fresh markets. The new " Weekly Recipes " series will provide shoppers with a steady stream of nutritious meal ideas that can be easily recreated at home. Selected fresh markets will also host the interactive "Smart Shopper Challenge", allowing shoppers to join fun games while buying groceries to win exciting rewards. results.title: DuPont to Showcase PPE Innovation and Integrated Protection Solutions at OGA 2026
results.description: Featuring the Malaysian debut of Tyvek® APXTM 400 and solutions designed for industrial workplace protection KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia , Aug. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- DuPont (NYSE: DD) today announced its participation in Oil & Gas Asia (OGA) 2026 , taking place from September 2-4, 2026, at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre. Building on decades of expertise in personal protection, DuPont continues to develop advanced solutions that help address evolving workplace needs across demanding industrial environments. A key highlight at OGA 2026 will be the Malaysian debut of Tyvek® APXTM 400, a new innovation platform designed to support worker safety, comfort and productivity in challenging industrial environments. DuPont will also showcase Tychem® 6000 SFR, an Edison AwardTM-winning innovation , highlighting its continued commitment to innovation in worker protection. In addition, DuPont will collaborate with industry partners Bullard and PolyScientific to showcase integrated protection solutions designed to help address workplace safety concerns in oil and gas operations and other high-risk work environments. "Protecting workers remains at the heart of our innovation efforts, and we recognize the growing importance of comfort in today's demanding work environments," said Be Ho Joo, Asia Pacific Tyvek® Sales Leader . "We remain committed to developing solutions that help address both protection and comfort needs for workers." Visitors can learn more about DuPont's latest products and integrated protection solutions at Hall 2, Booth #2201 during OGA 2026. results.title: MegazoneCloud Launches Its Gemini Enterprise Center of Excellence to Accelerate Enterprise AI Adoption
results.description: Dedicated division leverages multimodal AI and agentic workflows to move global clients from pilot to production. ROCHESTER, N.Y. , Aug. 26, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MegazoneCloud, a global AI-Native Managed Service Provider (MSP) and a Premier Partner in the Google Cloud Co-sell, Google Cloud Services, and Google Workspace Co-sell and Services Partner Paths, today announced the official launch of its Gemini Enterprise Center of Excellence (CoE) . The strategic initiative is a dedicated delivery practice built for the last mile of enterprise AI, where most initiatives stall between a promising pilot and a governed production system people actually use. Built on MegazoneCloud's foundational AI framework, engagements typically open with an AI Readiness Assessment or a one-day AI Use Case Discovery Workshop that converts AI ambition into a prioritized portfolio of production-ready opportunities. The CoE launches with three flagship Gemini Enterprise engagements, the first of an expanding portfolio of offerings and packaged solutions: GE Enablement: A secure, governed Gemini Enterprise environment integrated with Google Workspace, paired with the rollout and adoption programs that turn licenses into measurable productivity. GE Use Case Pilot to Production: A single high-value use case carried from validated pilot to governed production, with the data integration, evaluation, and governance rigor that separates working systems from stalled experiments. GE Agent Foundation & Orchestration Build: Co-developed agentic infrastructure: agent orchestration, automated evaluation and deployment pipelines, grounded knowledge retrieval with source citations, and secure data segregation for multi-tenant environments. Whether opting for Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), outcome-based delivery, or a hybrid model, clients get a custom engagement structured for their ideal way of working. " Partners are central to how we deliver Google Cloud's most advanced AI innovations to organizations worldwide ," said David Smith, Head of Global Channels and Programs, Google Cloud. " MegazoneCloud's launch of the Gemini Enterprise Center of Excellence is a powerful demonstration of how our partner ecosystem is moving customers from experimentation to execution ." " We are moving past isolated AI pilots and entering an era of deeply integrated, proactive intelligence ," said Bob Moore, MegazoneCloud US CEO. " By centralizing our expertise and leveraging advanced multimodal architectures, the CoE will empower our workforce, optimize core operational models, and deliver unprecedented value to our clients ." For clients, this investment translates directly to faster project delivery, smarter predictive managed services, and a secure path to co-developing custom AI solutions for their toughest operational challenges. Current offering details, engagement models, and the CoE delivery approach are available at us.megazone.com/gemini-enterprise-coe , where enterprises can request a Gemini Enterprise readiness conversation with the CoE team. About MegazoneCloud MegazoneCloud is a leading AI and cloud-native company, home to over 2,000 cloud and AI technology experts. As a trusted digital transformation partner to more than 8,000 clients worldwide, MegazoneCloud empowers innovation and growth through strategic partnerships and its suite of proprietary cloud, AI, and security solutions. Under its vision of "Transform Tomorrow, Together", MegazoneCloud is committed to building future-ready competitiveness for its customers—powered by cutting-edge technology, data, and the passion of its people. Operating in over 9 countries, including extensive operations in the US under the leadership of industry veteran Bob Moore, the company continues to grow alongside its global partners and clients. To learn more, visit: www.megazone.com/us .
